rule: Primary keyword must appear in H1 title
example: H1: NABH accreditation checklist 2025

rule: Primary keyword in first 150 words of page
example: Use exact phrase in opening paragraph

rule: Primary keyword in meta description
example: <meta name="description" content="NABH accreditation checklist...">

rule: Long-tail keywords in H2 subheadings
example: H2: How long does NABH full accreditation take?

rule: Page title under 60 characters
example: NABH HCO full accreditation guide | AccredReady

rule: Meta description 120-155 characters
example: Describe page content with primary keyword and CTA

rule: FAQ section mandatory on every /learn page
example: Minimum 4 FAQ questions per page

rule: Internal link to accredready.in homepage in every page
example: Link text: Track your NABH compliance free

rule: Author byline with credentials on every article
example: Dr. Mehul Upadhyay NABH-certified Quality Manager

rule: Published date and last updated date visible
example: Published: June 2025 | Updated: June 2026

rule: FAQ schema JSON-LD on every /learn page
example: Add FAQPage structured data

rule: Article schema on blog posts
example: Add Article structured data with author

rule: Canonical URL tag on every page
example: <link rel="canonical" href="https://accredready.in/learn/...">

rule: OG tags for social sharing
example: og:title og:description og:image

rule: Target zero search-volume NABH-specific terms
example: Own NABH ECO OE count — no competition

rule: Every /learn page links back to pricing/signup
example: CTA at end of every informational page

rule: Cross-link between related /learn pages
example: NABH HCO page links to SHCO comparison page

rule: Opening paragraph answers core question directly
example: AEO rule — no preamble allowed

rule: Specific numbers over vague claims
example: 639 OEs not hundreds of OEs

rule: Cite nabh.co as source for any standard claim
example: Never cite general knowledge for NABH facts
